title: Chapter 1287
text:
The news of the return of the Immortals spread like wildfire. In the current situation, this matter received even more attention, and many organizations were secretly shocked.

Tens of millions of immortal Grade B Supers, no one could ignore this force, especially since tens of millions of them were members of the Black Star Corps. This made many large organizations, including the three Universal Civilizations, vigilant, worried that the Black Star Corps would make a big move after their powerful armed forces returned.

However, many organizations heaved a sigh of relief very quickly. These Immortals of the army were immersed in their daily work, maintaining law and order, acting as mercenaries, and training everywhere. It seemed very harmonious, and there were no big moves.

However, every time they disappeared and returned, the strength of the Immortals would increase. This was a pattern that had been discovered. Many top organizations confirmed through their intelligence network that the stagnant strength of the Immortals had increased again, and they could not help but feel worried.

Although they were only Grade B, the Immortals were already very terrifying. Every organization knew that if the Immortals were allowed to continue growing, it would definitely have an impact on the current structure of the universe, causing unknown effects. It would not be a good thing.

Furthermore, the galactic society now knew about the existence of the Sanctum Revival, and they could not help but associate it with the immortal nature of the players.

On the internet, the public opinion that had cooled down a little became heated again. The galactic residents discussed it in full swing, giving a lot of guesses. One of them said that the reason Black Star had mastered the Sanctum Revival was because he had found clues on the Immortals.

This guess was reasonable and received the most widespread agreement. Countless galactic residents felt that they had discovered Black Star's secret.

All of a sudden, almost all the organizations in the universe offered more generous conditions for the Immortals, enthusiastically trying to rope them in, wanting to study the Sanctum Revival through the Immortals.

However, with the example of the Limitless Financial Group's collapse, coupled with the version name 'Black Star Era', most players rejected the olive branches of the small and medium-sized organizations and turned to the Black Star Army in batches. The number of players in the army once again soared.

Due to various reasons, many players had already missed out on several versions with the Black Star Army. Now that the new version had just started, it would be the best time to start afresh. Many of them did not want to miss out on this opportunity.

The movements of the players attracted the attention of the entire universe. Countless organizations were constantly paying attention, coveting and wary.

…

In the territory of the Black Star Corps, in a secret training ground hidden on a desolate planet.

On the rocky surface that was like a mountain range, two figures were exchanging blows. Their speed was extremely fast, leaving behind a series of afterimages as they crisscrossed back and forth. Every time they collided, a ring of air would explode.

Bang! Bang!

The two figures were entangled with each other as they sped on the ground. They were like an earth dragon that stirred up billowing smoke and dust. The surging scorching aura brought along the choking dust and sand. Their fists were exchanged back and forth, and their martial arts auras shot out violently. The rocky mountains along the way exploded one after another, causing the earth to tremble and mountains to shake.

Suddenly, the figure wearing the heavy training armor found a flaw in the opponent. He raised his elbow, and condensed Pugilist flames erupted at the point of contact, instantly pushing the opponent's defensive posture away. Taking advantage of this short opportunity, he suddenly threw out a powerful whip kick, like a battle axe sweeping horizontally, bringing along a sonic boom in the air and whipping the opponent's chest in the blink of an eye.

Bang!

Another silver figure suffered a heavy blow and shot out like a cannonball. It crashed into three rocky mountains and was embedded into the wall of the fourth small mountain. With a bang, it shook, and broken stones shot out in all directions, leaving behind a deep pit filled with smoke and dust. Spider web-like cracks quickly spread on the wall of the mountain.

"… Not bad."

The silver figure's body trembled, and the small mountain exploded, turning into a rain of rocks.

He floated in the air, his body like flowing silver liquid metal. The dent in his chest was quickly recovering. It was Yin Ying.

On the other side, his opponent did not pursue him. He took off his helmet, revealing a plain face. It was Carrott.

Yin Ying flew back to Carrott, nodded, and said, "Your improvement is getting faster and faster. Although it's only been a year, the current you can probably defeat three of yourself from a year ago. Your ability is already not bad among the Calamity Grade Supers."

"Am I that good?" Carrott scratched his head, feeling a little embarrassed. He was used to being at the bottom, so when he heard praise, he felt uncomfortable all over.

"Your Pugilist potential is something I've never seen before in my life. In time, your achievements might surpass mine."

Yin Ying's tone was filled with emotion.

He had suppressed his strength to fight with Carrott earlier. Although he had only displayed the strength of a Calamity Grade Supers, Carrott's performance had shocked him and even made him feel pressured.

Back then, when Black Star had asked him to teach Carrott, Yin Ying had been a little unwilling. However, after a year of teaching, he was really satisfied.

Carrott's strength had increased by leaps and bounds. If he was an ordinary Calamity Grade Supers before, he was now at the elite level, close to the Boss level. This huge transformation had only taken him a year!

Yin Ying saw the potential of a Beyond Grade A from Carrott, so not only did he not reject teaching, he even gave it his all and imparted his Pugilist experience to Carrott without holding back. If he could become a Beyond Grade A teacher, it would be a good thing for him as well.

Black Star had a wide range of friends and did not lack Pugilists. However, such a good thing had actually fallen into his lap. Yin Ying could not help but feel grateful to Han Xiao, feeling that Black Star was helping him.

However, Yin Ying did not teach Carrott wholeheartedly just because he wanted to groom a junior. As soon as he saw Carrott, he felt joy in his heart and secretly admired him. They were very compatible.

"It's all because you taught me well." Carrott smiled honestly.

"It's not all because of me. I also have to thank Black Star. His foresight is really too accurate. If not for him guiding me on how to teach you, I might not even have a clue now." Yin Ying shook his head.

Han Xiao had seen Carrott's growth mechanism through the interface, so he had asked Yin Ying to focus on specific training. He had first focused on explaining Pugilist comprehension and then high-intensity training. As a result, Carrott had improved by leaps and bounds within a year.

According to the original growth trajectory, Carrott was the type of person who matured late. However, the reason might be because he was not clear about his own characteristics and could only slowly explore and accumulate, so it took him a lot of time. If he had trained with a goal in mind from the start, perhaps Carrott's growth would not have been slower than others but much faster.

From another perspective, Carrott was really very similar to Great Hero Guo. Under his naive appearance hid extremely outstanding talent. It was just that he did not meet the best teacher and wasted too much time. If he had trained with an ultimate technique from the start, his combat strength would have been formed long ago.

The interface could see through a person's strengths and weaknesses and target their training. There was probably no other teacher in the universe who was more suitable than Han Xiao to teach according to the individual's aptitude.

Not only Carrott, but the hundreds of other Beyond Grade A seeds had all received his guidance and improved. Almost all of them treated Han Xiao as their spiritual teacher.

At this time, a remote projection appeared beside the two of them. It was Han Xiao.

"Your Excellency Black Star."

Yin Ying and Carrott immediately looked over and bowed.

"How's your training?" Han Xiao smiled.

"It's improved compared to last time. He can even break through my defense and kick me." Yin Ying revealed a faint gratified smile.

"Yo, not bad. Continue to work hard and enter the Beyond Grade A realm as soon as possible. When the time comes, I'll find more teachers for you to learn from." Han Xiao laughed heartily.

He had already figured out the correct way to train Carrott. The biggest hurdle of [Everlasting Martial Path] was to accumulate Pugilist understanding. The shortcut was to communicate with different Beyond Grade A Pugilists, which would allow Carrott's Pugilist understanding to complete the transformation of his talent and enter the fast path of leveling up.

When Carrott became a Beyond Grade A, Han Xiao planned to use his connections to get those Beyond Grade A Pugilists to impart their understanding to Carrott, not letting a single one of them go. With Carrott's simple and steady character, Han Xiao was sure that this investment would not lose money and would only be profitable.

After giving some instructions, Han Xiao ended the call and left.

Carrott exhaled, feeling extremely warm inside.

Over the past year, no matter how busy Black Star was, he would call every ten days to check on the progress of his training and specially develop a training plan for him. He even invited Silver Shadow, a Beyond Grade A Super, to be his teacher. All these actions showed how much Black Star valued him, and it was not a lie.

As the saying went, there would be no harm if there was no comparison. Thinking back to how the dynasty had treated him, even if Carrott was not a stingy person, he could not help but feel that there was no comparison between the two.

Carrott remembered all these favors in his heart. Even without the relationship of idolatry, his sense of belonging to Black Star had already broken through the sky.

The ruler treated me like a country knight, so I'll definitely repay him like a country knight!

…

In the office of Black Star Palace, Han Xiao retracted the remote projection and smiled.

"Carrott is really worth grooming. His growth in just a year is already so high. Based on this trend, he might catch up and become a Beyond Grade A even faster than Lothaire."

He could not be more satisfied with Carrott. He could only say that he was indeed the future face of the Pugilist class.

Lothaire was still stuck at the threshold of Beyond Grade A, and this step was the most difficult. He had no idea how long it would take.

In addition, Evans had been grooming for decades. Because the players were not online, he did not absorb any new abilities and had been polishing his core Esper Ability. Now that his strength had increased, he had steadily fulfilled the potential of his Esper Ability and successfully entered the Calamity Grade.

Han Xiao was full of expectations for this' Little EsGod '. Now that the players had returned, he could finally add new Esper Abilities to Evans and match them with specific combat styles.

Other than these few potential stocks, the high-end strength of the army had expanded several times. There were many Beyond Grade A seeds, and there were many people worth grooming.

Oh, right, there was also the bald baby, Sylvia.

Unfortunately, with Sylvia's potential, it would be good enough if she could become a Beyond Grade A seed. Han Xiao still felt that the position of Chief Administrative Official was more suitable for her.

Han Xiao shook his head, took out his communicator, and looked at it.

"The outside world is reacting to the return of the players. They're worried that if they continue to grow, they will become more and more lawless, shaking the order of the galactic society. This is actually not wrong. The fuse has already appeared."

In ancient times, there was a saying that heroes used martial arts to break the law. When it came to the players, this characteristic was even more exaggerated. The stronger they were, the harder it was to manage them. Han Xiao considered it from the perspective of the three Universal Civilizations and could understand that the Calamity of the Supers had its reasons. At least, it was very suitable for the players.

"The three Universal Civilizations should be making a move soon. I keep feeling that something is going to happen."

Han Xiao rubbed his forehead and frowned.

At this time, a black flame suddenly appeared in front of him and quickly expanded into a figure. It was Oathkeeper's mental projection.

Han Xiao looked up at him and raised his brows. "Why didn't you say anything? Why are you looking for me? Have you gathered another set of keys? "

"Not yet." Oathkeeper's tone was solemn. "Black Star, I have two pieces of bad news for you."

"Oh? What is it? "Han Xiao was curious.

"There's a traitor among the group of avengers. He wants to sell the information about the Holy Covenant and the Sanctums in exchange for the help of the advanced civilizations to take revenge."

Han Xiao's face darkened. "How did this happen? Has the news been leaked? "

"Pangon is chasing after him. The information has been intercepted and has not been sent out."

Han Xiao frowned. "What's the other bad news?"

"Someone used magic to spy on the Holy Covenant organization. We traced the source and found that the magic path came from the secondary dimensions. We've probably been discovered by someone hiding in the secondary dimensions. We don't know who it is yet," Oathkeeper said with a deep voice.

Hearing this, Han Xiao slowly stood up and put on his cloak.

"Tell me the coordinates. I'll go take a look."
